description: Turns a person's goals, or their wheel-of-life ratings (eight areas rated 1 to 10), into a structured vision board plan: three or four sections, each with scenes to picture, affirmations to write under them and a slot for the first step, plus how to keep the board in use. Goals the library does not know are kept in the person's own words. Use when someone wants help planning or laying out a vision board.

goals.description: Goals in the person's words, most important first, e.g. ["run a marathon", "pay off my debt"]

life_ratings.description: Optional wheel-of-life ratings, 1 to 10. The lowest-rated areas become sections.

name.description: First name to put in the affirmations, optional

tone.description: Tone of the affirmations, default gentle

name: plan_vision_board
title: Plan a vision board
